evidence: Independent 325-case census exactly matches the archived histograms and finds zero survivors.
The claimed transfer from the circulant translate code to an arbitrary symmetric design is invalid without cyclic-development structure.
First multiplier theorem gives 2 as a multiplier for any planar abelian (157,13,1) difference set because 2 divides k-lambda=12.
ord_157(2)=52, so a 2-fixed translate can only have size from unions of orbit sizes 1,52,52,52; size 13 is impossible. Thus the entire cyclic case is classically excluded.
The correct census is only a computational confirmation of a subcase already ruled out by a stronger classical theorem.
